steps.content: Oliver coldly watches as you attempt to get up a few times without any intention of helping.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: What did you say your plan was just now?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Collect all the toys to make everything normal again? Save your friend with your own power? Hahahahahaha...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: How can a tattered rag doll brag so shamelessly?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Oliver?

The little tyke before you feels like a stranger now. Even though Oliver had been using and deceiving you from the start, your goals had always been the same. This is the first time you see such blatant rebellion from the kid.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you leaving?
Your muffled voice leaks from your cotton lips, eliciting a predictable sneer in response.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: I thought so highly of you, yet you ended up like this... Ah, adults really can't be relied on!

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: In the end, it all depends on Oliver!
Special threads made of Mania power shoot out from Oliver's palm and mockingly poke your ragged body. Oliver then stands up and stretches lazily.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're... a Sinner?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Yup. Even though I look like a cute kid, I do have special powers. I just don't want to get hurt, so I prefer to use other ways.
Pleased by the successful cover-up, Oliver eagerly awaits your flattery and pleas for mercy. Unfortunately, you just don't know how to be "spineless"...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mania powers stem from emotional and mental strength. Eve and her family are always there for each other. Even if they've become toys, they still want to protect Eve. But you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You want to abandon me the moment you think I'm of no use to you. You think you have the willpower to win against them?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You saw the memories in that room, didn't you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But you refuse to admit... that your selfishness and cunning can't defeat the power of this family bond... Ugh!!
Threads of Mania tightly bind your mouth. Oliver leans in, forcing an impatient smile.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: You must be tired from all that talking. Let Oliver help you save your energy to deal with the upcoming enemy. Isn't Oliver thoughtful?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: No need to thank me. This is what I should do as a good kid...
The kid casually pokes your cotton body again in revenge, then skips off and disappears into the shadows at the end of the corridor.
Only you, with your mouth bound, and a doll that has lost consciousness, are left in place.

Oliver's footsteps echo further and further into the distance until they can't be heard anymore. Dead silence blankets the empty space. Apart from the occasional breath leaking from your cotton mouth, there is nothing to break the silence.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm, mmm mmm mmm mmm... (Kids these days... they really have no patience...)

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm, mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm mmm... (Once everything is over, I'll bring Oliver back to the MBCC for some proper education...)

Your consciousness is somewhat blurred. The scene in front of you is twisting and spinning, but lying here won't solve anything. Your willpower helps you regain a bit of control over your limbs. You drag the doll and crawl along the dusty floor.
Things aren't as bad as they seem. You can still move, and still sense your shackles... Even if Oliver has run off, you are not far off from gathering all the toy family members.
"Thud, thud."
You hear the sound of wood hitting the ground, and start to head in that direction.
"Thud, thud, thud."
Finally, a red nesting doll appears close by.
"Have you seen a wooden sheep with a black face?" "What other stories does this factory have?" You want to ask loudly but can't open your mouth.
"Thud thud thud thud thud thud."
The sound gets more and more intense. You even feel the floor trembling.
Though your physical condition is terrible, you are sure that what you hear and see in front of you is not an illusion. Hundreds of nesting dolls are rushing towards you.

As they approach you, they continue to crack open, spitting out other nesting dolls from their bodies. The dense sea of red nesting dolls spread and reproduce infinitely, covering your entire vision like a locust tide...
